import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.feature_selection import f_classif

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Find strongest correlates of outcome
    f_stats, p_values = f_classif(feats.x, feats.y)
    feature_scores = [(feats.ids[i], f_stats[i], p_values[i]) 
                      for i in range(len(feats.ids))]
    feature_scores.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
    
    # Filter out correlated features (keep one from each pair)
    correlated_pairs = set()
    for i, (fid1, fid2, r) in enumerate([
        ("MMF16", "EYT17", 0.97), ("URAR13B", "AKH2P", -0.93),
        ("SEAB16L", "URAR13B", -0.91), ("URAR13B", "OENV7A", 0.88),
        ("QJER9", "URAR13B", -0.87), ("URAR13B", "WOME1L", -0.87),
        ("SLDT7", "DSL8", 0.86), ("CBOY9", "UOUM15A", 0.84),
        ("URAR13B", "UGD16", 0.84), ("SEAB16L", "OENV7A", -0.83),
        ("SEAB16L", "AKH2P", 0.83), ("PPAI15P", "URAR13B", -0.82),
        ("WOME1L", "AKH2P", 0.81), ("QJER9", "WOME1L", 0.80),
        ("QJER9", "SEAB16L", 0.80), ("PPAI15P", "AKH2P", 0.80),
        ("SEAB16L", "WOME1L", 0.80), ("QJER9", "AKH2P", 0.79),
        ("URAR13B", "KSLG5P", 0.79), ("PPAI15P", "SEAB16L", 0.79)
    ]):
        if abs(r) >= 0.6:
            correlated_pairs.add((fid1, fid2))
    
    # Remove near-duplicates
    kept_features = set()
    filtered_features = []
    for fid, score, pval in feature_scores:
        keep = True
        for kept_fid in kept_features:
            if (fid, kept_fid) in correlated_pairs or (kept_fid, fid) in correlated_pairs:
                keep = False
                break
        if keep:
            kept_features.add(fid)
            filtered_features.append((fid, score, pval))
    
    # Check if any features have strong association with outcome
    strong_features = [fid for fid, _, pval in filtered_features if pval < 0.05]
    
    # If we have very few strong features, return empty design
    if len(strong_features) < 2:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Select top candidates for drivers
    drivers = []
    for fid, _, _ in filtered_features[:MAX_DRIVERS]:
        if feats.types[feats.ids.index(fid)] == 'clinical' or \
           feats.types[feats.ids.index(fid)] == 'cohort':
            drivers.append(fid)
    
    # If no clinical/cohort features found, use top features
    if not drivers:
        drivers = [fid for fid, _, _ in filtered_features[:MAX_DRIVERS]]
    
    # Build columns and products based on strongest features
    columns = [fid for fid, _, _ in filtered_features[:5]]  # Top 5 features
    
    # Add interaction terms between top features
    products = []
    for i, fid1 in enumerate(columns[:3]):
        for j, fid2 in enumerate(columns[:3]):
            if i < j:
                products.append((fid1, fid2))
    
    # Create loadings for weighted score
    loadings = {}
    for i, fid in enumerate(columns[:3]):
        loadings[fid] = float(i + 1) / len(columns[:3])
    
    return Design(drivers=tuple(drivers), columns=tuple(columns), 
                  products=tuple(products), loadings=loadings)
